meta.priority_scale: P0 = MVP-critical, P1 = Phase 2, P2 = Phase 3-4, P3 = Phase 5 / opportunistic
meta.effort_scale: S < 1 wk, M = 1-3 wk, L = 1-2 mo, XL = quarter+

core_features.name: Broker Import Hub
core_features.description: One-click import of trade history via broker APIs (IBKR, Alpaca, Tradier, Binance, Bybit, MetaTrader reports) and CSV fallback. Value before any capture is installed.
core_features.business_value: Removes onboarding friction; instant time-to-value; table stakes vs journals

core_features.name: Automated Trade Journal
core_features.description: Zero-effort journal: every executed trade auto-logged with entry/exit, size, R-multiple, fees, screenshots of chart context at execution time.
core_features.business_value: The Trojan horse — must match best-in-class journals to earn adoption

core_features.name: Trade Plan Capture
core_features.description: Lightweight pre-trade plan: intended entry, stop, target, size, thesis. Becomes ground truth for plan-vs-execution deviation analytics.
core_features.business_value: Highest-signal intent data with explicit user consent; powers discipline scoring

core_features.name: Browser Extension Intent Capture (TradingView)
core_features.description: Extension instrumenting TradingView: charts opened/revisited, drawings, alerts, order ticket open/edit/cancel, hover dwell on buy/sell. Local buffering, <5ms overhead, granular consent scopes.
core_features.business_value: The differentiating data source; nothing downstream exists without it

core_features.name: Intent Event Ingestion Pipeline
core_features.description: Ingestion gateway + immutable event log: schema validation, idempotency, ordering, enrichment with market context at capture time.
core_features.business_value: The company's foundational asset; everything is a view over this log

core_features.name: Intent Session Clustering
core_features.description: Groups raw intent events into IntentSessions per instrument/timeframe window so downstream scoring operates on coherent decision episodes.
core_features.business_value: Converts noise into analyzable decision units

core_features.name: Heuristic Intent Scorer v1
core_features.description: Transparent weighted scoring of intent probability from session features (ticket opened, size typed, stop drawn, dwell time). Conservative thresholds, fully explainable.
core_features.business_value: Ships intent inference a year before ML is ready; bootstraps labels

core_features.name: Abandoned Entry Phantom
core_features.description: When intent_score crosses threshold and no trade follows, spawn a phantom tracking the inferred trade (entry/stop/target from drawings, ticket values, or defaults) to resolution.
core_features.business_value: The signature feature — measures the cost of hesitation, which no competitor can

core_features.name: Premature Exit Phantom
core_features.description: For every manually-closed winner, simulate holding to plan target / trailing rule. Quantifies money left on the table per exit decision.
core_features.business_value: Works with zero intent capture installed — broker data alone; fastest wow moment

core_features.name: Phantom Ledger
core_features.description: Browsable record of all phantoms: status (active/resolved/expired), outcome distribution, linked real decision. Always shown as distributions, never single-trade taunts.
core_features.business_value: Makes the invisible dataset tangible to the user

core_features.name: Hesitation Cost Metric
core_features.description: Aggregate statistic: expected R lost to abandoned/delayed entries over a period, with confidence interval and minimum-sample gating.
core_features.business_value: The headline number in marketing and the weekly report

core_features.name: Daily Summary Dashboard
core_features.description: 30-second glance: today's trades, intent sessions, new phantoms, one highlighted insight. Calm, no engagement bait.
core_features.business_value: Daily habit anchor

core_features.name: Weekly Behavioral Report
core_features.description: The core ritual: weekly email + in-app review of behavioral stats, phantom outcomes, DNA movement, one recommended focus. Designed for a 15-minute Sunday session.
core_features.business_value: Primary retention mechanism and shareable artifact

core_features.name: Decision DNA Baseline Profile
core_features.description: After ~3 weeks of silent capture, the 'reveal': initial behavioral profile across DNA dimensions with confidence levels and percentile context.
core_features.business_value: The signature emotional moment of onboarding; drives word of mouth

core_features.name: Consent & Capture Control Center
core_features.description: Granular, legible toggles for every capture scope; live view of what is being observed; pause-all switch.
core_features.business_value: Trust is the precondition for the entire data strategy

core_features.name: Quick Intent Note
core_features.description: One-tap 'I almost took this trade' manual log with prefilled instrument/price/time — explicit intent declaration where capture isn't installed.
core_features.business_value: High-quality labeled intent data; works on any platform including mobile

core_features.name: Setup Taxonomy & Trade Tagging
core_features.description: User-defined setup library with auto-tag suggestions; all behavioral analytics sliceable by setup.
core_features.business_value: Behavioral patterns differ per setup; required for credible insights

core_features.name: R-Multiple & Risk Analytics
core_features.description: Standard journal analytics done properly: R distribution, expectancy, win rate by setup/time, MFE/MAE.
core_features.business_value: Table stakes for journal parity

core_features.name: Insight Feed
core_features.description: Ranked feed of statistically-gated insights from insight-service. Each insight: claim, evidence distribution, sample size, suggested action.
core_features.business_value: The product's voice; where behavioral intelligence is consumed

core_features.name: Full Data Export & Deletion
core_features.description: Machine-readable export of all raw events, trades, phantoms, profiles; hard-delete pipeline honoring data principles.
core_features.business_value: Trust, compliance (GDPR/CCPA), enterprise prerequisite

behavioral_features.name: Decision DNA Engine
behavioral_features.description: Computes the dimensional behavioral profile: Conviction, Hesitation/Fear, FOMO, Patience, Discipline, Risk Tolerance, Adaptability, Consistency, Emotional Stability, Loss Aversion, Recency Bias, Overtrading Propensity. Each with score, confidence, trend.
behavioral_features.business_value: The durable identity layer of the product; basis of B2B evaluation later

behavioral_features.name: Fear Index
behavioral_features.description: Composite of hesitation frequency, abandoned-high-intent rate, under-sizing vs plan, stop-tightening behavior — contextualized by market regime.
behavioral_features.business_value: Most relatable single metric for the wedge user

behavioral_features.name: Conviction Index
behavioral_features.description: Measures alignment between expressed intent strength and executed size/persistence; detects conviction collapse at execution moment.
behavioral_features.business_value: Directly monetizable insight: conviction-weighted sizing gaps are quantifiable money

behavioral_features.name: FOMO Detector
behavioral_features.description: Flags chase entries: late entries after extended moves with no prior intent session, entries within minutes of large candles, social-hours clustering.
behavioral_features.business_value: High-frequency pain point; strong retention driver

behavioral_features.name: Revenge Trade Detector
behavioral_features.description: Detects post-loss re-entry patterns: shortened inter-trade interval, size escalation, same-instrument re-entry after stop-out.
behavioral_features.business_value: Single most destructive retail behavior; prop firms care intensely

behavioral_features.name: Overtrading Monitor
behavioral_features.description: Personal baseline of trade frequency vs edge decay; flags sessions where marginal trades historically destroy expectancy.
behavioral_features.business_value: Quantifies 'less is more' per individual instead of as a platitude

behavioral_features.name: Discipline / Plan-Adherence Score
behavioral_features.description: Per-trade deviation between captured plan and execution (entry drift, stop moves, early exits, size changes), aggregated to a discipline score.
behavioral_features.business_value: The metric prop firms will eventually buy; start accruing history now

behavioral_features.name: Tilt Detection
behavioral_features.description: Within-session deterioration detector: decision-interval compression, plan-adherence collapse, size variance spike following drawdown.
behavioral_features.business_value: Foundation for the most valuable alert in the product

behavioral_features.name: Behavioral Percentile Benchmarks
behavioral_features.description: Anonymous, k-anonymity-gated (k>=50) percentiles per DNA dimension across the user base, segmented by style/market/experience.
behavioral_features.business_value: Network effect: every new trader sharpens everyone's context

behavioral_features.name: Behavioral Goals & Interventions
behavioral_features.description: User commits to one behavioral target (e.g., 'hold winners to plan'); platform tracks it with phantom-verified evidence and structured check-ins.
behavioral_features.business_value: Moves product from diagnosis to treatment — the Phase 3 thesis

behavioral_features.name: Improvement Evidence Tracker
behavioral_features.description: Longitudinal, statistically honest measurement of behavioral change: pre/post distributions per dimension with significance testing.
behavioral_features.business_value: Proof the product works — the core marketing and enterprise asset

behavioral_features.name: Pre-Session Mindset Check-In
behavioral_features.description: Optional 20-second pre-market state log (sleep, stress, focus); correlated against session behavior over time.
behavioral_features.business_value: Cheap feature, unique dataset linking state to behavior

behavioral_features.name: Inference Correction Loop
behavioral_features.description: Every inferred intent/phantom is user-correctable ('I wasn't planning this'). Corrections become labeled training data and immediately adjust the user's record.
behavioral_features.business_value: Simultaneously a trust feature and the label-generation engine for ML

behavioral_features.name: Behavioral P&L Attribution
behavioral_features.description: Decomposes period P&L into strategy expectancy vs behavioral deltas (hesitation cost, early-exit cost, sizing cost, tilt cost) using phantom baselines.
behavioral_features.business_value: The single most differentiated analytic in the product

simulation_features.name: Phantom Engine Core
simulation_features.description: Stateless worker fleet that spawns, advances, resolves, and expires phantoms against market data. Deterministic, replayable, versioned simulation logic.

simulation_features.name: Market Replay Data Service
simulation_features.description: Candle/tick store with point-in-time correctness for simulation: no lookahead, exchange-calendar aware, multi-asset (equities, futures, FX, crypto).
simulation_features.business_value: Simulation credibility depends entirely on this layer

simulation_features.name: Fill & Slippage Model
simulation_features.description: Conservative execution model for phantoms: spread, slippage by liquidity bucket, partial-fill assumptions, fees. Documented and published.
simulation_features.business_value: Quant-proofing; prevents the 'fantasy fills' critique that would kill credibility

simulation_features.name: Delayed Entry Phantom
simulation_features.description: Simulates the trade as planned at original intent time vs as actually executed later; isolates the cost/benefit of waiting.
simulation_features.business_value: Separates healthy patience from costly hesitation — a key coaching distinction

simulation_features.name: Delayed Exit Phantom
simulation_features.description: For trades held past plan target/stop, simulates the planned exit; measures cost of overstaying.
simulation_features.business_value: Completes the exit-quality picture alongside premature exits

simulation_features.name: Conviction Phantom
simulation_features.description: Re-simulates executed trades at plan-consistent (full conviction) size; aggregates the sizing gap into 'conviction cost'.
simulation_features.business_value: Often the largest hidden number for profitable traders — strong upsell hook

simulation_features.name: Position Size Phantom
simulation_features.description: Counterfactual P&L under alternative sizing policies (fixed-fractional, volatility-scaled, plan size) over the user's actual trade sequence, including drawdown paths.
simulation_features.business_value: Turns sizing debates into evidence; popular with prop traders

simulation_features.name: Stop Placement Phantom
simulation_features.description: Simulates original (pre-adjustment) stop placements vs moved stops; quantifies the cost of stop-tightening and stop-pulling per habit.
simulation_features.business_value: Addresses one of the most common destructive interventions

simulation_features.name: Opposite Personality Phantom
simulation_features.description: Portfolio-level simulation of the user's trade history under an inverted behavioral policy (e.g., 'you, but patient'): same setups, behaviorally-transformed execution. Strictly presented as aggregate distributions.
simulation_features.business_value: The most narratively powerful artifact in the product; must obey anti-regret laws

simulation_features.name: Phantom Lifecycle & Pruning
simulation_features.description: Expiration policies (time-stop, structure invalidation, account-irrelevance), archival to cold storage, and pruning of low-information phantoms to control cost and noise.
simulation_features.business_value: Keeps the corpus meaningful and the compute bill sane

simulation_features.name: Phantom Ranking & Information Value
simulation_features.description: Scores each phantom by expected insight value (intent confidence x outcome divergence x pattern membership) to decide what surfaces to users.
simulation_features.business_value: Signal-to-noise control; protects Law 1 (distributions, not anecdotes)

simulation_features.name: Counterfactual Uncertainty Bands
simulation_features.description: Every phantom P&L carries a distribution from fill/path uncertainty (Monte Carlo over slippage and intra-bar path assumptions), rendered as bands everywhere.
simulation_features.business_value: Statistical honesty as a brand asset

simulation_features.name: Portfolio-Level Phantom Aggregation
simulation_features.description: Period-level rollups: phantom-adjusted equity curve, total behavioral alpha/cost decomposition with confidence intervals.
simulation_features.business_value: The executive summary view of everything the engine knows

ai_features.name: Learned Intent Model v2
ai_features.description: Sequence model (transformer over intent-event streams) predicting execution probability per IntentSession, trained on captured sessions with executed/abandoned outcomes plus correction labels.
ai_features.business_value: Core proprietary model; accuracy compounds with the data moat

ai_features.name: Intent Calibration Monitoring
ai_features.description: Continuous Brier score and reliability-curve tracking per cohort and model version; auto-alerts on calibration drift; gates model promotion.
ai_features.business_value: Miscalibrated intent poisons every downstream system; this is the safety rail

ai_features.name: Behavioral Embedding Model
ai_features.description: Learned trader-behavior embeddings from event/trade sequences; powers similarity search, cohorting, archetype discovery, and DNA dimension refinement.
ai_features.business_value: Unsupervised structure discovery over a dataset only we have

ai_features.name: DNA Inference Engine v2
ai_features.description: Replaces heuristic DNA scoring with model-based estimation: hierarchical Bayesian per-dimension scores with population priors, shrinkage for small samples, explicit confidence.
ai_features.business_value: Statistically defensible profiles — prerequisite for B2B evaluation use

ai_features.name: Coaching Narration Engine
ai_features.description: LLM layer that converts structured insight payloads into personalized, tone-calibrated coaching text. Hard constraint: narrates pre-computed numbers only; never computes or invents statistics.
ai_features.business_value: Makes intelligence feel like a coach, not a spreadsheet

ai_features.name: Insight Generation Engine
ai_features.description: Pipeline that mines validated statistical patterns (per-user and cohort), applies sample-size/significance/novelty gates, ranks by actionability, and emits Insights.
ai_features.business_value: The product's voice; enforces product laws programmatically

ai_features.name: Personalization Engine
ai_features.description: Learns which insight types, tones, and cadences each user acts on; adapts delivery accordingly.
ai_features.business_value: Coaching that adapts is coaching that retains

ai_features.name: Pre-Tilt Risk Prediction
ai_features.description: Real-time model predicting elevated probability of tilt behavior in the current session from early-session signals; powers the highest-value alert in the product.
ai_features.business_value: Prevention beats diagnosis; flagship enterprise capability for risk desks

ai_features.name: Behavioral Anomaly Detection
ai_features.description: Detects departures from a trader's own baseline (sudden size spikes, novel instruments, frequency shifts) for self-awareness and firm risk surfaces.
ai_features.business_value: Cheap to build on embeddings; valuable to both B2C and B2B

ai_features.name: Behavioral Fix Recommendation Engine
ai_features.description: Maps diagnosed patterns to ranked interventions with expected-value estimates ('rule X would have saved ~2.1R/mo at 80% CI'), validated against phantom evidence.
ai_features.business_value: Closes the loop from insight to action; justifies Pro pricing

ai_features.name: Online Learning & Label Pipeline
ai_features.description: Continuous ingestion of outcomes and corrections into training stores; scheduled retraining with shadow deployment, champion/challenger evaluation, and rollback.
ai_features.business_value: Operationalizes the flywheel: more usage, better models, automatically

ai_features.name: Natural-Language History Query
ai_features.description: Ask questions over your own record ('show my Thursday FOMO entries on NQ this quarter') compiled to validated queries — never free-form LLM math.
ai_features.business_value: Discoverability of depth without dashboard sprawl

ai_features.name: Model Registry & Provenance
ai_features.description: Versioned registry of all models with training-data lineage, eval metrics, and per-inference provenance stamped onto stored scores.

ai_features.name: Counterfactual Personality Simulation
ai_features.description: ML-driven behavioral policy transforms behind the Opposite Personality Phantom: learned mappings from DNA profile deltas to execution-policy changes.

ai_features.name: Eval-Pass Prediction (Prop)
ai_features.description: Predicts probability a prop-eval trader passes/keeps funding from behavioral trajectory; trained on consented prop cohort outcomes.
ai_features.business_value: Directly priced into prop-firm contracts; unique training data

analytics_features.name: Phantom-Adjusted Equity Curve
analytics_features.description: Actual equity curve overlaid with behavioral-counterfactual bands (e.g., 'plan-adherent you'), with uncertainty shading.
analytics_features.business_value: The most screenshot-shared artifact in the product

analytics_features.name: Decision Graph Explorer
analytics_features.description: Interactive visualization of Market Event -> Attention -> Intent -> Action -> Outcome chains; filter by instrument, setup, outcome divergence.
analytics_features.business_value: Makes the causal model of the product tangible; power-user magnet

analytics_features.name: Temporal Behavior Analytics
analytics_features.description: Behavioral metrics by time-of-day, day-of-week, session phase, and around news events ('your fear is expensive on Thursdays').
analytics_features.business_value: Concrete, actionable slicing users immediately act on

analytics_features.name: Exit Quality Analytics
analytics_features.description: MFE/MAE capture ratios, exit-efficiency distribution, premature-vs-late exit decomposition with phantom evidence.
analytics_features.business_value: Exits are where most behavioral money leaks; strongest journal upgrade

analytics_features.name: Sizing Analytics
analytics_features.description: Size-vs-plan deviation distributions, size-vs-outcome correlation, conviction-collapse frequency by context.
analytics_features.business_value: Pairs with conviction phantoms to quantify the sizing gap

analytics_features.name: Streak & Drawdown Behavior Analysis
analytics_features.description: How behavior mutates during winning/losing streaks and drawdowns: adherence, frequency, size variance trajectories.
analytics_features.business_value: Reveals the regime-dependence of discipline — a universal blind spot

analytics_features.name: Cohort Benchmark Reports
analytics_features.description: K-anonymous comparisons against style/experience-matched cohorts on behavioral dimensions and behavioral costs.

analytics_features.name: Calendar & Heatmap Views
analytics_features.description: Behavioral calendar: discipline, activity, and phantom-cost heatmaps over days/weeks.

analytics_features.name: Custom Report Builder
analytics_features.description: Composable report blocks (metrics, distributions, phantom rollups) with saved templates and scheduled delivery.

analytics_features.name: Period Comparison Engine
analytics_features.description: Statistically honest this-month-vs-last comparisons across all behavioral metrics with significance indicators.

analytics_features.name: Coach Client Analytics
analytics_features.description: Coach-facing dashboard over consented client rosters: DNA summaries, focus areas, week-over-week movement, session prep packets.
analytics_features.business_value: Each coach brings 10-50 traders; force-multiplier channel

analytics_features.name: News/Event Context Overlay
analytics_features.description: Economic calendar and volatility-regime tagging on all behavioral analytics, separating regime effects from trait effects.

platform_features.name: Auth, MFA & Session Security
platform_features.description: Email/OAuth sign-in, TOTP MFA, secure session management, Argon2id credential storage.

platform_features.name: Billing & Subscriptions
platform_features.description: Stripe-based tiers (Free/Trader/Pro/Team), trials, proration, dunning, tax handling.

platform_features.name: Broker Integration Framework
platform_features.description: Pluggable connector SDK with normalized trade/position schema, OAuth/key vaulting (AES-256-GCM), webhook + polling adapters, health monitoring.
platform_features.business_value: Each connector widens the funnel; framework keeps marginal cost low

platform_features.name: TradingView Webhook Ingestion

platform_features.business_value: Zero-extension intent signal from the largest retail platform

platform_features.name: MetaTrader 4/5 Capture EA

platform_features.name: Mobile Companion App

platform_features.name: Public API & Webhooks Out

platform_features.name: Notification System
platform_features.description: Email/push digests honoring the calm philosophy: batched, scheduled, never intraday-noisy by default.

platform_features.name: Team Workspaces
platform_features.description: Multi-trader workspaces with shared visibility rules, per-field consent matrix, and aggregate team views.

platform_features.name: Roles, Permissions & Sharing

platform_features.name: Audit Logging
platform_features.description: Immutable audit trail of all access to behavioral data, surfaced to the data owner ('who viewed my profile').

platform_features.name: Observability & Admin Platform
platform_features.description: OpenTelemetry tracing, structured logging (PII-scrubbed), pipeline-lag dashboards, capture-health monitoring per integration, internal admin tools.
platform_features.business_value: Silent capture failure = silent data loss = moat erosion; must be visible

platform_features.name: Decision Graph Store
platform_features.description: Graph projection service maintaining DecisionNodes/DecisionEdges from the event stream (Postgres adjacency, replayable).
platform_features.business_value: Backbone of graph explorer and causal analytics

platform_features.name: Privacy Center
platform_features.description: Self-serve data inventory, export, deletion, consent history, and capture-scope management in one legible surface.
platform_features.business_value: Radical transparency as a marketing asset, not a compliance cost

enterprise_features.name: Prop Firm Evaluation Dashboard
enterprise_features.description: Firm-facing view of eval-cohort behavioral quality: process scores, rule adherence, risk-behavior flags — beyond 30-trade outcome stats.
enterprise_features.business_value: The flagship enterprise product; solves prop firms' core business problem

enterprise_features.name: Trader Behavioral Scorecards
enterprise_features.description: Standardized, confidence-rated behavioral scorecards per trader for allocation and development decisions, with trader-consented visibility.
enterprise_features.business_value: The artifact firms pay per-seat for

enterprise_features.name: Firm-Level Benchmarks
enterprise_features.description: Internal cohort benchmarks (desk vs desk, cohort vs industry aggregate) built on the cross-firm dataset only we possess.
enterprise_features.business_value: Pure data-moat monetization; impossible to replicate without our corpus

enterprise_features.name: Risk-Behavior Alerting
enterprise_features.description: Real-time desk alerts on tilt prediction, anomaly detection, and rule-breach precursors, routed to risk managers with policy controls.
enterprise_features.business_value: Prevents blowups; easiest enterprise ROI story

enterprise_features.name: Rule-Adherence Compliance Monitor
enterprise_features.description: Configurable firm rule engine (max daily loss, size limits, restricted hours) with behavioral-precursor warnings, not just post-hoc breach reports.
enterprise_features.business_value: Maps directly to prop-firm operating costs

enterprise_features.name: SSO / SAML / SCIM
enterprise_features.description: Enterprise identity: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, directory-mapped roles.

enterprise_features.name: Enterprise Data Controls
enterprise_features.description: Custom retention policies, regional data residency, VPC peering / private deployment option, DPA tooling.

enterprise_features.name: Bulk Seat & Cohort Management
enterprise_features.description: Firm admin: invite cohorts, manage seats, lifecycle traders through eval -> funded -> alumni states.

enterprise_features.name: Firm API & Data Export
enterprise_features.description: Firm-scoped API over consented trader aggregates and scorecards for integration with internal risk systems.

enterprise_features.name: Coach Workspace (Professional)
enterprise_features.description: Practice-management tier for coaches/psychologists: client rosters, consented data views, session prep packets, progress evidence.

enterprise_features.name: Hedge Fund PM Analytics
enterprise_features.description: Execution-behavior analytics for PMs/execution traders: hesitation cost on idea implementation, sizing-conviction alignment at book scale.

enterprise_features.name: Enterprise Audit & Reporting Pack
enterprise_features.description: Exportable, board-ready behavioral risk reports; full access-audit trails; model-provenance documentation for diligence.

future_features.name: Native Desktop Capture Terminal
future_features.description: Our own order-ticket and watchlist surface routing to user brokers — first-party, full-fidelity intent capture without platform dependence.
future_features.business_value: Removes the largest platform-dependence risk; deepest capture fidelity

future_features.name: Wearable / HRV Integration
future_features.description: Opt-in physiological context (HRV, sleep) correlated with behavioral metrics; strictly user-private by default.

future_features.name: Voice Session Debriefs

future_features.name: Options & Futures-Specific Phantom Models
future_features.description: Counterfactual models honoring greeks/expiry for options and roll/margin mechanics for futures.

future_features.name: Split-Roads Score (Industry Standard)
future_features.description: Portable, trader-owned behavioral certification that firms accept in hiring/funding decisions — the 'credit score' of trading process quality.

future_features.description: K-anonymous behavioral indices (e.g., retail hesitation index by regime) for research desks — opt-in, aggregate-only, never individual grain.

future_features.name: Embedded Broker Partnerships
future_features.description: White-label behavioral insights inside broker/prop platforms ('powered by Split-Roads'), with capture built into partner order flows.
future_features.business_value: Distribution at platform scale; capture without extensions

future_features.description: Opt-in periodic screen-context understanding (what chart/timeframe is in focus) for platforms with no API surface; on-device processing only.
